title: Somebody That I Used To Know
description: 《Somebody That I Used To Know》描寫一段感情結束後，昔日親密的戀人逐漸變成陌生人的痛苦與矛盾。歌曲透過男女雙方不同的角度，呈現分手後的失落、委屈與誤解。男方雖然慶幸感情終於結束，卻無法接受對方突然切斷聯繫，彷彿過去的一切從未存在。女方則認為自己曾經受到傷害，不願繼續承受責怪與情緒壓力，因此選擇離開。兩人都覺得自己受了委屈，卻始終無法真正理解彼此。最終，《Somebody That I Used To Know》傳達的是愛情中的傷害、誤解與疏離：即使曾經深愛一個人，當感情失去信任與理解，最熟悉的人也可能變成最陌生的存在。

vocabulary.usage: 談到偶爾會做或間中發生的事。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Now and then」？

Now and then, I call my old friend to say hello.
Please put the now and then in my bag.
My cousin is very now and then about the concert.

vocabulary.usage: 當人、地方或事情出現在腦海裡時使用。

optionExplanations: 錯誤：resignation 不是能放進書包的物品。
錯誤：resignation 是名詞，不可直接當形容詞使用。
正確：resignation to the result 表示無奈接受結果。
錯誤：resignation 不是飲品。
questions.explanation: 正確：resignation to the result 表示無奈接受結果。

questions.meaning: 承認；坦承
questions.usage: 常見 admit that + 子句、admit + -ing；通常承認原本不想說的事。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「admit」？
options: I admit that I forgot your birthday.
I admitted to went home very late.
He admitted with making the mistake.
She admits the lunch to be at six.
optionExplanations: 正確：admit that 後接完整子句，坦承忘了生日。
錯誤：admit to 後接 going，而非 went。
錯誤：應說 admitted making 或 admitted to making。
錯誤：不自然地把 admit 當作安排用餐時間。
questions.explanation: 正確：admit that 後接完整子句，坦承忘了生日。

questions.meaning: 裝作；假裝事情是某種樣子
questions.usage: 非常口語，這裡指把情況說得彷彿如此；正式寫作可用 pretend。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「make out like」？

He made out like nothing was wrong, but he was upset.
I made out like the door with a key.
They made out like into the kitchen after school.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：make out like 後應接完整說法，不是 like to have。
正確：假裝一切正常，實際上心情不好。
錯誤：不能以此表示用鑰匙開門。
錯誤：make out like 不是表示走進廚房。
questions.explanation: 正確：假裝一切正常，實際上心情不好。

questions.meaning: 陌生人
questions.usage: 指不認識的人；也可形容熟人態度變得疏遠。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「stranger」？
options: I stranger to the shop at nine.
The stranger was my best friend since birth.
A stranger asked me where the station was.
She bought a stranger for her birthday cake.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：stranger 是名詞，不是表示去某地的動詞。

正確：不認識的人詢問車站位置。
錯誤：stranger 不是蛋糕原料或可購買的東西。
questions.explanation: 正確：不認識的人詢問車站位置。

questions.meaning: 難受的；艱難的；粗糙的
questions.usage: 可形容艱難經歷或粗糙表面；歌中指受到對待時心裡不好受。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「rough」？
options: He made the tea rough by reading a book.
Her rough was standing beside the door.
It was a rough week because I was ill.
I rough my shoes before leaving home.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：讀書不會自然地讓茶變得 rough。
錯誤：rough 不適合如此單獨作可數名詞。
正確：a rough week 指不好過的一週。
錯誤：rough 通常是形容詞，不是穿鞋的動詞。
questions.explanation: 正確：a rough week 指不好過的一週。

questions.meaning: 自貶身價；做出卑劣的事
questions.usage: 批評某人為達目的而做出不道德、卑鄙的行為；非指身體彎低。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「stoop so low」？
options: He stooped so low to pick up his pencil.
The child stooped so low under the table to hide.
She stooped so low because the door was short.
I never thought she would stoop so low as to cheat.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：撿鉛筆是字面彎腰，不是道德上的卑劣。
錯誤：鑽桌下是身體動作，不是卑劣行為。
錯誤：因門矮而彎腰是字面動作。
正確：stoop so low as to cheat 指竟卑鄙到作弊。
questions.explanation: 正確：stoop so low as to cheat 指竟卑鄙到作弊。

questions.meaning: 收集；領取；取回
questions.usage: 可以指逐一收集物品，也可指到某處領取某物。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「collect」？
options: I collected the rain because I felt tired.
We collected our bags after the school trip.
She collected to the library on her bicycle.
My brother collected happy from his new book.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：句子沒有自然的收集雨水情境，疲倦也不構成理由。
正確：旅行後取回自己的行李。
錯誤：collect 不表示騎車前往圖書館。
錯誤：happy 是形容詞，不能當作這裡的收集物。
questions.explanation: 正確：旅行後取回自己的行李。

questions.meaning: 坑害某人；欺騙或不公平地對待某人
questions.usage: 非正式且帶粗魯語氣，通常用於遭到背叛、欺騙或佔便宜時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「screwed me over」？
options: He screwed me over by giving me a fair price.
The seller screwed me over by taking my money and sending nothing.
I screwed me over when I tied my shoes.
She screwed me over by helping me win fairly.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：公平定價沒有顯示坑害。
正確：收錢卻不寄貨，是不公平的欺騙行為。
錯誤：反身代名詞應是 myself，繫鞋帶也不是欺騙。
錯誤：公平幫助獲勝不等於坑害。
questions.explanation: 正確：收錢卻不寄貨，是不公平的欺騙行為。

questions.meaning: 過度解讀；對……想太多
questions.usage: read into + 言行：從話語或行為推斷出可能不存在的隱含意義。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「reading into」？
options: You are reading into his short reply; he may just be busy.
I read into the book for my English test yesterday.
She reads into the window to see the rain outside.
We read into the bus because it comes at eight.
optionExplanations: 正確：對簡短回覆過度推測其意思。
錯誤：閱讀一本書一般說 read the book。
錯誤：透過窗戶看風景用 look through the window。
錯誤：read into 不表示搭公車。
questions.explanation: 正確：對簡短回覆過度推測其意思。

questions.meaning: 撞見；發現某人正在做某事
questions.usage: catch + 人 + -ing：意外發現某人正做某事；歌中表示「不會逮到你還在……」。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「catch」？
options: I caught him looking at my notes during the test.
I caught my sister to eat my cake.
They caught the children to played outside.
She caught my teacher was walking to school.
optionExplanations: 正確：catch someone doing something 表示當場發現對方正在做事。
錯誤：這個句型應接 eating，不是 to eat。
錯誤：應使用 playing，不是 to played。
錯誤：應說 caught my teacher walking，不接 was。
questions.explanation: 正確：catch someone doing something 表示當場發現對方正在做事。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 表示偶爾發生，而非每天的習慣。
questions.usage: 想提及不定期發生的活動時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你偶爾去探望鄰居。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I now and then my neighbor a letter.
Now and then, I visit my old neighbor.
Every morning is now and then for my family.
I bought two now and thens at the shop.
optionExplanations: 此片語不是可以取代 send 的動詞。
now and then 作時間副詞片語，放在句首自然。
every morning 是每天，不能與偶爾畫上等號。
此片語不是可數物品。
questions.cue: Now and then I think of
questions.explanation: now and then 作時間副詞片語，放在句首自然。

questions.word: think of + 名詞／疑問詞子句
questions.meaning: 想起某人、某事，或回憶一段時光。
questions.usage: 回想以前共同經歷的片段時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你看著照片回憶旅行。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I think of when did we visit the beach.
I think of to meet my cousin tomorrow.
I think of when we went to the beach together.
I think my old trip of every night.
optionExplanations: 間接疑問子句不使用 did we 的問句語序。
of 後不能直接接 to meet；應說 think about meeting。
of 後接 when 引導的陳述語序子句，表示回憶何時一起去海邊。
think of 的介系詞位置錯了。
questions.cue: I think of when we were together
questions.explanation: of 後接 when 引導的陳述語序子句，表示回憶何時一起去海邊。

questions.meaning: 指出過去某段事件發生的時候。
questions.usage: 說明某件回憶的時間背景。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 說明你們住在同一條街的時候。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: When we lived on the same street, we often talked.
When we live on the same street yesterday, we often talked.
When did we lived on the same street, we often talked.
When we living on the same street, we often talked.
optionExplanations: when 後用完整過去式子句 lived。
昨天的語境需用過去式 lived。
時間子句不用疑問句倒裝，且 did 後須用原形。
缺少 were 或應改用 lived。
questions.explanation: when 後用完整過去式子句 lived。

questions.meaning: 轉述他人說過的內容；that 可以省略。
questions.usage: 回想別人先前說的話。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 朋友告訴你她累了。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: Maya said that tired after the walk.
Maya said me she was tired after the walk.
Maya said was tired after the long walk.
Maya said she was tired after the long walk.
optionExplanations: that 後缺少主詞和動詞。
say 通常不能直接接「人＋子句」；可用 told me。
that 子句缺少主詞。
said 後接 she was tired 的完整子句。
questions.cue: you said you felt so happy
questions.explanation: said 後接 she was tired 的完整子句。

questions.word: so + 形容詞 + 結果子句
questions.meaning: 程度非常高，後面的子句誇張說明結果；原詞省略 that。
questions.usage: 用生動方式表達非常強烈的感覺。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 形容看表演時笑得停不下來。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: The show so funny that we could not stop laughing.
The show was so funny we could not stopping laugh.
The show was so funny that we could not stop laughing.
The show was such funny that we could not stop laughing.
optionExplanations: 缺少系動詞 was。
could not 後接原形 stop，stop 後接 laughing。
so funny that 引出結果 we could not stop laughing。
such 後通常接名詞片語，不能直接修飾 funny。
questions.explanation: so funny that 引出結果 we could not stop laughing。

questions.meaning: 對自己說、說服自己相信某件事；歌詞省略主詞 I。
questions.usage: 整理自己的想法或給自己鼓勵時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你第一次參加舞蹈比賽。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I told myself to that I could dance.
I told myself that could dance in front of people.
I told me that I could dance in front of people.
I told myself that I could dance in front of people.

that 子句缺主詞 I。
主詞是 I，應用 myself，不是 me。
主詞 I 的反身代名詞是 myself，後接 that 子句。
questions.cue: Told myself that you were right for me
questions.explanation: 主詞 I 的反身代名詞是 myself，後接 that 子句。

questions.meaning: 表示人或選擇很適合某個人。
questions.usage: 選課、選工作或決定合作夥伴時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你喜歡戶外工作，選擇花園工作。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: This job is right for because I love working outside.
This job is right to me because I love working outside.

This job is right for me because I love working outside.

表示適合某人一般用 for，不用 to。
缺少 is。

questions.explanation: be right for me 表示這份工作適合我。

I felt a nervous when I stayed home alone.
I felt nervous when I stayed home alone.
I felt nervously when I stayed home alone.

felt 後接形容詞 nervous，表示當時感覺緊張。
nervously 是副詞，不是此處的主詞補語。
questions.explanation: felt 後接形容詞 nervous，表示當時感覺緊張。

questions.usage: 補充說明某件自己記得或珍惜的事。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 描述去年做的禮物。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。

This is the gift made I for my mother last year.
optionExplanations: gift 後省略受詞關係代名詞 that，made 已經以 gift 為受詞。
重複放 it，造成受詞多餘。
需要過去式 made。
關係子句詞序不對。
questions.explanation: gift 後省略受詞關係代名詞 that，made 已經以 gift 為受詞。

questions.meaning: 表達可能性或能力；can 後用原形。

You can spend too much time on this game.
You can spends too much time on this game.

can 後不能直接用 -ing。
can 後面是原形 spend。
can 後動詞不可加 -s。

questions.usage: 提醒自己別太依賴網路或遊戲時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你的朋友花太久時間玩手機遊戲。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。

He got addicted to play games on his phone.

addicted to 後接 playing（動名詞）。
標準搭配是 addicted to。
介系詞 to 後要接動名詞。
questions.explanation: addicted to 後接 playing（動名詞）。

questions.word: a certain kind of + 名詞
questions.meaning: 表示某一種特定類型，但不必說明全部細節。
questions.usage: 想談某種類型的音樂或感覺時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你在店內尋找特定種類的茶。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I am looking for a certain kinds of tea.

I am looking for a certain kind of tea.

questions.explanation: a certain kind of 後接 tea 這個名詞。

questions.meaning: 發現或了解到某件事為真。
questions.usage: 某次實驗後發現新的情況時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你發現植物需要更多水。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: We found the plants that needed more water.
We found that the plants needed more water.

We found that the plants needs more water yesterday.
optionExplanations: 這句變成找到了植物，而非發現一項事實。

子句語序不正確。
過去發現的結果使用 needed，主謂時態須一致。

questions.prompt: · 情境： 朋友上週說她隔天會打電話。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。

Last week, she said she would call me the next day.
Last week, she said she will called me the next day.
Last week, she said she would called me the next day.
optionExplanations: would 後不加 to。
said 表示過去轉述，would call 表達從當時看未來。
will called 組合錯誤。
would 後面須接原形 call。
questions.explanation: said 表示過去轉述，would call 表達從當時看未來。

questions.meaning: 承認一件可能不容易說出口的事。
questions.usage: 坦白自己真正的想法時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你承認自己忘了朋友生日。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I admit that forgot my friend's birthday.
I admit to that I forgot my friend's birthday.
I admit that I forgetting my friend's birthday.
I admit that I forgot my friend's birthday.
optionExplanations: that 子句缺主詞。
admit that 前面不加 to。
I forgetting 缺助動詞且時態不合。
admit that 接完整子句 I forgot...。
questions.cue: I'll admit that I was glad
questions.explanation: admit that 接完整子句 I forgot...。

questions.word: did not have to + 原形
questions.meaning: 表示過去其實沒有必要做某件事；不是說事情沒發生。
questions.usage: 向朋友表示不必特地送禮。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 有人花錢買很貴的花送你。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: You didn't have buying such expensive flowers.
You didn't had to buy such expensive flowers.
You didn't have to buy such expensive flowers!
You didn't have to bought such expensive flowers.
optionExplanations: have to 後接原形動詞。
didn't 後用 have，不是 had。
didn't have to buy 指原本沒有必要買。
didn't 後面動詞用原形 buy。
questions.cue: you didn't have to cut me off

pattern.text: didn't have to + 動詞原形

questions.explanation: didn't have to buy 指原本沒有必要買。

questions.word: cut + 人 + off（可分動詞片語）
questions.meaning: 在本歌表示突然斷絕聯絡，也可表示打斷說話。
questions.usage: 描述朋友突然封鎖你的訊息時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你突然無法聯絡以前常聊天的人。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: She cut off me and never answered my calls again.
She cut me off because we still talk every night.
She cut me of and never answered my calls again.
She cut me off and never answered my calls again.
optionExplanations: 可分片語中代名詞必須放中間。
仍每晚聯絡不符合此題的「斷聯」意思。
off 拼字與形式錯。
代名詞 me 放在 cut 與 off 之間，且語境是斷聯。
questions.explanation: 代名詞 me 放在 cut 與 off 之間，且語境是斷聯。

questions.word: make out like + 子句（口語）
questions.meaning: 口語中表示裝作某事如此；並非「親吻」的 make out。
questions.usage: 有人假裝沒有打破花瓶時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 看見朋友打破杯子卻假裝不知道。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: He made out like nothing happening yesterday.
He made out to like nothing had happened.
He made out like nothing had happened.
He made out like did nothing happen.
optionExplanations: 缺少 was 等助動詞。
make out like 中不插入 to。
made out like 後接完整的 nothing had happened。
語序不合陳述句。
questions.cue: Make out like it never happened
questions.explanation: made out like 後接完整的 nothing had happened。

questions.meaning: 以對待某種人的方式對待他人。
questions.usage: 描述有人像對待家人一樣照顧動物。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 小狗是家裡很重要的一員。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: They treat their dog like a member of the family.
They treat their dog like to a family member.
They treat their dog as like a member of the family.
They treat like their dog a member of the family.
optionExplanations: treat + dog + like + 名詞片語的順序正確。
like 後面接名詞片語，不用 to。
like 前不需要 as。
受詞 dog 應緊接 treat。
questions.explanation: treat + dog + like + 名詞片語的順序正確。

questions.meaning: 描述某件事帶來的感覺；rough 在歌中是難受。
questions.usage: 談一段很累人的經驗。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 走了一整天以後，腳很疲倦。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: My feet feel so tiring after the long walk.
My feet feel so tired after the long walk.
My feet feel so tiredly after the long walk.
My feet feels so tired after the long walk.
optionExplanations: tiring 是令人疲倦，不能自然表示腳本身累。
複數 feet 配 feel，後面用形容詞 tired。
tiredly 是副詞，不能作此處補語。
複數主詞不配 feels。
questions.explanation: 複數 feet 配 feel，後面用形容詞 tired。

questions.word: have + 人 + 原形動詞（使役）
questions.meaning: 請、安排某人做某事；不同於 have to 的義務。
questions.usage: 安排朋友幫忙領包裹時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你上班無法接包裹。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I will have my brother pick up the box for me.
I will have my brother picking up the box for me.
I will have picked up my brother the box for me.
I will have my brother to pick up the box for me.
optionExplanations: have + brother + 原形 pick up 是使役用法。
此框架要用原形 pick。
誤用完成式且受詞順序錯。
使役 have 後不接 to。
questions.cue: Have your friends collect your records
questions.explanation: have + brother + 原形 pick up 是使役用法。

questions.meaning: 以 that 子句限制是哪一個人；這裡 that 在子句中當受詞。
questions.usage: 介紹以前認識的人時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你在照片中指認以前一起工作的朋友。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: That is somebody that I work with him years ago.
That is somebody that worked I with years ago.
That is somebody that I worked with him years ago.
That is somebody that I worked with years ago.
optionExplanations: 年份 years ago 要用過去式，且多加 him。
關係子句語序錯。
多加 him，造成受詞重複。
that 指 somebody，worked with 的受詞已由 that 承擔。
questions.cue: somebody that I used to know
questions.explanation: that 指 somebody，worked with 的受詞已由 that 承擔。

questions.word: used to + 原形：過去與現在不同
questions.meaning: 表示過去持續的習慣或狀態，現在已經不同。
questions.usage: 比較自己小時候和現在的生活。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 小時候住在海邊，現在住城市。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I used to live near the sea, but now I live in the city.
I was used to live near the sea, but now I live in the city.
I used live near the sea, but now I live in the city.
I used to lived near the sea, but now I live in the city.
optionExplanations: used to live 指以前住，現在已改變。
was used to 是不同的結構，後通常接名詞或 -ing。
缺少 to。
used to 後接原形 live。
questions.explanation: used to live 指以前住，現在已改變。

questions.word: all the times + 限定子句
questions.meaning: 把過去多次發生的事件當成一組回憶；that 可省略。
questions.usage: 想起朋友多次幫忙的經歷時。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你回想姊姊多年來幫助你的次數。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I remember all the times helped you me.
I remember all the times you helped me.
I remember all the times you helped me them.
I remember all the times you help me yesterday years ago.
optionExplanations: 子句詞序錯誤。
times 後省略 that，you helped me 為限定子句。
受詞重複添加 them。
過去多次經歷應以 helped 表達，時間語也不通順。
questions.cue: all the times you screwed me over
questions.explanation: times 後省略 that，you helped me 為限定子句。

questions.word: have + 人 + -ing（使某人持續某狀態）
questions.meaning: 使某人持續相信、感到或做某件事；與 have 人＋原形的使役不同。
questions.usage: 描述一部電影讓大家一直猜結局。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 電影情節不斷變化，觀眾一直猜。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: The film had us guessing until the end.
The film had us to guessing until the end.
The film had us guessings until the end.
The film had we guessing until the end.
optionExplanations: had + us + guessing 表示使我們持續猜測。
此結構不加 to。
guessing 不加複數 s。
have 後應使用受格 us。
questions.explanation: had + us + guessing 表示使我們持續猜測。

questions.word: 過去完成式 had + 過去分詞
questions.meaning: 在另一個過去時間點之前已經完成的動作。
questions.usage: 回想原以為物品遺失，但其實早已收好。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你昨天找不到鑰匙，想起前一天已放進抽屜。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I remembered that I had put the key in the drawer.
I remembered that I had putted the key in the drawer.
I remembered that I had puts the key in the drawer.
I remembered that I have put the key in the drawer yesterday.
optionExplanations: had put 是過去完成式；put 的過去分詞仍是 put。
put 的過去分詞不是 putted。
had 後不能用 puts。
敘述昨天以前更早的事，這裡以 had put 表達更清楚。
questions.explanation: had put 是過去完成式；put 的過去分詞仍是 put。

questions.word: want to + 原形（wanna 口語）
questions.meaning: wanna 是 want to 的口語拼寫，表達不想做某事。
questions.usage: 與朋友聊天表示不想再熬夜。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 朋友約你今晚再次熬夜。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I don't wanna staying up late again.
I don't wanna to stay up late again.
I don't wanna stayed up late again.
I don't wanna stay up late again.
optionExplanations: wanna 後接原形動詞。
wanna 已包含 to。
wanna 後不能接過去式。
wanna 後直接接原形 stay，不能再加 to。
questions.cue: I don't wanna live that way
questions.explanation: wanna 後直接接原形 stay，不能再加 to。

questions.word: read into + 名詞（過度解讀）
questions.meaning: 把沒有明說的額外意思讀進某人的話；本歌為 -ing 片語。
questions.usage: 朋友擔心一則簡短訊息暗藏不滿。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 朋友只回「OK」，你想勸對方別想太多。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: Don't read too much into to the word "OK."
Don't read too much into the word "OK."
Don't read too much in the word "OK."
Don't read too much into the word "OK" is.
optionExplanations: into 後不再加 to。
read into 是固定搭配，too much 表示過度解讀。
此義用 into，不用 in。
句尾多了 is。
questions.cue: Reading into every word you say
questions.explanation: read into 是固定搭配，too much 表示過度解讀。

questions.word: let + 人／物 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 允許某人做事，或讓某事離去；let it go 在此指放下。
questions.usage: 你勸朋友放下小小的失誤。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 朋友因昨天打翻果汁一直難過。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: It was an accident. You can let go it.
It was an accident. You can let it go.
It was an accident. You can let it going.
It was an accident. You can let it to go.
optionExplanations: 這個片語代名詞 it 應在 let 與 go 中間。
let + it + go，代名詞放中間，go 用原形。
let 後不接 going。
let 後不加 to。
questions.explanation: let + it + go，代名詞放中間，go 用原形。

questions.word: catch + 人 + 形容詞／分詞補語
questions.meaning: 發現某人處於某種狀態或正在做某件事。
questions.usage: 偶然看到哥哥偷偷唱歌。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你在廚房發現哥哥正在唱歌。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: I caught my brother singing in the kitchen.
I caught my brother sang in the kitchen.
I caught my brother to sing in the kitchen.
I caught my brother sings in the kitchen.
optionExplanations: caught + brother + singing 表示撞見當時正在唱歌。
需要 -ing 表示被撞見的動作。
此處 catch 後不用 to sing。
sings 不能直接當此處受詞補語。
questions.cue: I wouldn't catch you hung up on somebody
questions.explanation: caught + brother + singing 表示撞見當時正在唱歌。

questions.meaning: 口語指一直放不下某人或某件往事；歌中省略系動詞，作補語。
questions.usage: 朋友一直難忘以前的同事。
questions.prompt: · 情境： 你描述朋友一直談起前任。 選出唯一一個文法、用法及語境都正確的英文句子。
options: He is still hung up for his ex.
He still hung up on his ex every time he calls.
He is still hung up on his ex.
He is still hung up to his ex.
optionExplanations: 此搭配不用 for。
這句較像「掛電話」且時態結構不完整，不能清楚表達指定感情狀態。
be hung up on 指情感上放不下前任。
介系詞應是 on。
questions.explanation: be hung up on 指情感上放不下前任。
